blocks.html: This year, Robinsons Malls takes your kids to the best Halloween parties packed with fun activities and amazing take-away treats. Block off your weekend (October 28-29) and get your kids ready for Robinsons Malls’ Halloween parties from north to south. Heroes and Villains Dress your little ones as Wonder Woman, Katniss Everdeen, or even Princess Leia! Better yet, have fun, go on the darker side and let your kids channel Magneto, Joker, or Green Goblin- just for fun! Witness the fun-filled clash of cutesy heroes and villains as they participate in interactive games, DIY activities, Martial arts exhibition, exciting trick or treat parade, magic show, meet and greet with superheroes, costume contest and food booths at the following Robinsons Malls- Robinsons Place Manila on October 28 at the Midtown Wing and Level 2 Adriatico Wing; Robinsons Otis on October 29 at the Activity area; Robinsons Magnolia on October 29 at the Activity Area and with a minimum single receipt purchase of P1,000; Robinsons Place Lipa on October 29 at the Activity Area; Robinsons Tagaytay on October 29 at the Activity Area; and Robinsons Place Palawan on October 29 at the Activity Area. Registration starts at 10 AM while events start as early as 1 PM! Wizards and Witches Witches, wizards, warlocks, sorcerers, however you might want to call these magical beings, unfortunately connote cruelty and wickedness. But at Robinsons Malls, wizards and witches are all about love, kindness and good time! Think Sabrina the Teenage Witch, Harry Potter, Hermione, Samantha of Bewitched, Dumbledore, and Gandalf the Grey! This Halloween, let your kids experience spellbinding activities such as magic and puppet shows, balloon twisting activities, costume contests, amazing trick or treat parades and exciting game booths. Take a trip down south and celebrate Halloween at the following Robinsons Malls Start off with Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on October 29 at 4 PM; Robinsons Place Imus and Robinsons General Trias on October 29 at the activity area, registration starts at 10 AM; and at Robinsons Place Las Piñas and Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños on October 29, at the grand atrium at 2 PM. Monster Party Did you ever imagine what a monster party would look like? Cute little kids in onsies- costumes with gooey eyes and in bright colored furs! Spend the weekend at Robinsons Sta. Rosa and get the chance to see these adorable monsters parade around the mall and enjoy the different activities prepared for them – Pumpkin Ring Toss, Feed the Monster game, Apple Shoot Out, and Cotton Candy and Popcorn Booth. Registration starts at 10 AM while program starts at 1PM. To see a complete line-up of Robinsons Malls’ Halloween party and activities, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or follow Facebook: /RobinsonsMalls , Instagram: @RobinsonsMallsOfficial, and Twitter: @RobinsonsMalls.
